rationale: FAA AC 25.1309-1A explicitly establishes that compliance is framed around a logical and acceptable inverse relationship between the probability and severity of each failure condition (paragraphs 3 and 4a), substantiated through a safety assessment, qualitative analyses, tests, and selective/supplemental quantitative analyses where justified (paragraphs 4a, 4b, and 10). The claim's historical framing and explicitly limited scope (noting it is not an AI/learned-model acceptance method) match both the source text and all artifact uses.
limitations: AC 25.1309-1A is advisory and historical (issued 1988); modern certification projects may utilize later revisions or issue papers, and its conventional component-level probability framework does not directly translate to learned perception models.
